scope: Short constructed native working-data ENOSPC fault; no host disk filling or live official-oracle claim
filesystem: Fresh separate disposable filesystem of at most 64 MiB; all evidence and original seed outside it
sequence: Start native disk/WAL suite and acknowledge one Unicode document, one Auth account and one Storage object
Fill only the exclusive synthetic capacity-fill file until the OS returns ENOSPC even for a one-byte allocation and available space is zero
Attempt a two-document atomic batch, an Auth account mutation and a Storage upload; each must fail actionably with the OS no-space error
Further Firestore writes must be fenced with an explicit restart requirement
Shutdown/export fails nonzero but drains owned components and retains native state
Remove only the synthetic filler after shutdown, then reopen the same native store
Recover every acknowledged value; an unacknowledged batch may be present or absent but never partial, and an unacknowledged object may be complete or absent but never partial
A fresh write and portable export must succeed after recovery
limitations: Not host power-loss qualification, network-filesystem support or final full-data acceptance. Test disk image and exact failed/successful evidence are retained.
